Class RatCheckMojo

java.lang.Object
org.apache.maven.plugin.AbstractMojo
org.apache.rat.plugin.BaseRatMojo
org.apache.rat.mp.AbstractRatMojo
org.apache.rat.mp.RatCheckMojo
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.maven.plugin.ContextEnabled, org.apache.maven.plugin.Mojo
@Mojo(name="check", defaultPhase=VALIDATE, threadSafe=true) public class RatCheckMojo extends AbstractRatMojo
Run RAT to perform a violation check.

This documentation mentions data types for some arguments.
